en.title: Fed Pause Eases 2026 Recession Fears
en.summary: The probability of a US recession by end of 2026 decreased by 2.0% to 18%, primarily driven by expectations that the Federal Reserve will hold interest rates this year. This signals a pause in tightening, reducing immediate economic pressure despite persistent inflation and global growth concerns.
drivers: Fed to hold rates this year, per Reuters poll.
Reduced immediate risk of further monetary tightening.
Market interprets Fed's stance as avoiding an imminent policy-induced recession.
en.why_matters: The Fed's policy path is crucial for economic stability, as prolonged high rates or further hikes could trigger a downturn, impacting employment and investment.
en.bull_case: Persistent inflation and global slowdowns will eventually force the Fed to hike or lead to a recession by 2026.
en.bear_case: Fed's rate hold provides stability, allowing the economy to absorb current rates without immediate recession by 2026.

zh.title: 美联储暂停加息缓解2026年衰退担忧
zh.summary: 截至2026年底美国经济衰退的可能性下降2.0%至18%，主要原因是市场预期美联储今年将维持利率不变。这表明紧缩政策暂停，尽管通胀持续且全球增长放缓，但短期经济压力有所减轻。
drivers: 路透调查显示美联储今年将维持利率不变。
进一步货币紧缩的即时风险降低。
市场解读为避免政策性衰退。
zh.why_matters: 美联储的政策路径对经济稳定至关重要，长期高利率或进一步加息可能引发经济下行，影响就业和投资。
zh.bull_case: 持续通胀和全球经济放缓最终将迫使美联储加息或导致2026年前衰退。
zh.bear_case: 美联储维持利率不变提供稳定性，经济可在现有利率下避免2026年前衰退。
